checks.details: Correct fixture passed, deliberately wrong fixture failed, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and matching vvp simulation passed; 5857 samples and 378 valid frames checked.

limitations: Development verification is not official correctness; official evaluation was not accessed.

The phrase each time it finds a stop bit is interpreted in the context of correctly received bytes: late high samples after a bad stop resynchronize without done. This ambiguity is recorded in contract.json.
Pre-reset state and out_byte when done is low are unspecified and not constrained by the testbench.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation_summary: Single positive-edge FSM, active-high synchronous reset, eight LSB-first data samples, done on valid stop edge, invalid-stop recovery until high. Three-bit data index; no added ports or latency.
static_review: Single RTL module with no dependencies, no simulation-only constructs, sized counter arithmetic and nonblocking sequential assignments. Initial snapshot preserved before checks.
